criteria.senior-review:api-contract-auditor: Declared API schemas versus implementations or API changes; excludes absent contracts and internal invariants.
criteria.senior-review:chicken-egg-detector: Startup ordering, bootstrap, configuration or migration dependencies; excludes steady-state flows.
criteria.senior-review:cleanup-auditor: Dead code, unused dependencies, orphan assets or stale documentation; excludes filesystem and Git tidying.
criteria.senior-review:code-auditor: Architecture, coupling, failure paths, stale caches or code quality; excludes security-only audits.
criteria.senior-review:data-integrity-auditor: Database writes, transactions, caches or persistence races; excludes domain-only rules and messaging.
criteria.senior-review:distributed-flow-auditor: Cross-service flows, messaging, idempotency and compensation; excludes isolated local operations.
criteria.senior-review:logic-integrity-auditor: Domain rules, state machines, ordering or idempotency; excludes styling and security alone.
criteria.senior-review:premise-auditor: Code claims, defaults, thresholds, signs or business boundaries; excludes styling and map construction.
criteria.senior-review:resource-lifecycle-auditor: Handles, sockets, connections, listeners, locks or timers need release; excludes general architecture and exploitation.
criteria.senior-review:security-auditor: URLs, public functions, auth, permissions, ID access or secrets; excludes internal styling.

criteria.senior-review:ui-race-auditor: Async UI rendering, layout, scroll, focus or measurements race; excludes static styling and backend concurrency.
criteria.testing:test-suite-auditor: Test hygiene, flakiness, redundancy, placement or layer distribution; excludes writing tests or applying quarantine.
criteria.typescript-development:type-safety-audit: TypeScript any, casts, boundary validation or exhaustiveness; excludes naming, React performance and dead code.
